# IMRango – Privacy-Focused Software & Utility Tools
IMRango provides free browser-based productivity tools for Excel, CSV, JSON, XML, text, audio, image, and file management — fast, secure, and private.


## Audio Tools
[Audio Tools](https://iamrango.com/audio-tools): Convert and manage audio files.  
[Audio Converter](https://iamrango.com/audio-converter): Universal audio conversion tool.  
[AAC to MP3](https://iamrango.com/aac-to-mp3): Convert AAC to MP3 format.  
[AIFF to MP3](https://iamrango.com/aiff-to-mp3): Convert AIFF to MP3.  
[ALAC to MP3](https://iamrango.com/alac-to-mp3): Convert ALAC files to MP3.  
[AMR to MP3](https://iamrango.com/amr-to-mp3): Convert AMR to MP3.  
[CAF to MP3](https://iamrango.com/caf-to-mp3): Convert CAF files to MP3.  
[M4A to MP3](https://iamrango.com/m4a-to-mp3): Convert M4A audio to MP3.  
[OGG to MP3](https://iamrango.com/convert-ogg-to-mp3): Convert OGG to MP3.  
[Opus to MP3](https://iamrango.com/opus-to-mp3): Convert Opus to MP3.  
[MP3 to MP4 with Image](https://iamrango.com/mp3-to-mp4-with-image): Add images to MP3 and export as MP4.  

**FAQs**  
**Q: Is audio quality preserved?**  
A: Yes, conversions maintain high audio quality.  
**Q: Do these tools run online?**  
A: Yes, they are fully browser-based.  

---

## Image Tools
[Image Tools](https://iamrango.com/image-tools): Edit and convert image files online.  
[JPG to JPEG](https://iamrango.com/jpg-to-jpeg): Convert JPG to JPEG format.  
[PDF Image Converter](https://iamrango.com/pdf-image-converter): Convert PDFs into images and vice versa.  

**FAQs**  
**Q: Can I use these tools for privacy protection?**  
A: Yes, the redactor removes sensitive information from images.  
**Q: Do they support batch conversion?**  
A: Some tools allow multiple image conversions.

## Video Tools
[Video Tools](https://iamrango.com/video-tools): Convert and manage video files online — fast, secure, and privacy-focused.

[MOV to GIF](https://iamrango.com/mov-to-gif): Convert MOV videos into animated GIFs instantly and share them easily.  
[MOV to MP3](https://iamrango.com/mov-to-mp3): Extract MP3 audio from MOV videos without losing quality.  
[MOV to MP4](https://iamrango.com/mov-to-mp4): Transform MOV files into MP4 for smooth playback on all devices.  
[MOV to WAV](https://iamrango.com/mov-to-wav): Convert MOV video files into WAV audio format in seconds.  
[MP4 to GIF](https://iamrango.com/mp4-to-gif): Turn MP4 videos into smooth, high-quality GIF animations.  
[MP4 to MOV](https://iamrango.com/mp4-to-mov): Convert MP4 videos to MOV format for Apple and editing software compatibility.  
[Video to GIF](https://iamrango.com/video-to-gif): Create GIFs from any video format — MOV, MP4, WebM, and more.  
[WebM to GIF](https://iamrango.com/webm-to-gif): Convert WebM videos to GIFs with transparency preserved.  
[MP4 to MP3](https://iamrango.com/mp4-to-mp3): Extract MP3 audio from MP4 videos quickly and securely.

**FAQs**  
**Q: Can I convert videos offline?**  
A: Yes, all conversions run entirely in your browser after the page loads.  

**Q: Which video formats are supported?**  
A: MOV, MP4, WebM, and most common video formats are supported.  

**Q: Can I create high-quality GIFs from videos?**  
A: Yes, GIFs can be generated in high resolution while keeping file sizes reasonable.  

**Q: Can I extract audio from any video format?**  
A: Yes, tools like MOV to MP3 and MP4 to MP3 support multiple video sources.  

**Q: Are my files private during conversion?**  
A: Absolutely — all tools work locally in the browser, no uploads are made.  

**Q: Does it support HD and 4K videos?**  
A: Yes, high-resolution videos are supported depending on your device.  

**Q: Is trimming or editing possible before conversion?**  
A: Yes, basic trimming and previewing are available in most video tools.
